warm_definition: 100 burn-in queries per engine, then measured queries; service kept running, worker/metadata caches and OS caches warm
cold_definition: service process restarted (Turbofish server / Qdrant), no burn-in, first 20 queries measured. OS page cache and MinIO are NOT dropped; Qdrant serves from local disk/mmap, Turbofish must fetch objects from MinIO

dataset.ground_truth: exact brute-force cosine top-10 over all docs (numpy, no index involved)
